धरुण: 1. धरुण, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see p. 451, col. 3), Ved. carrying, holding, supporting, one who supports or keeps; (अस्), m. the supposed author of a hymn of the Ṛg-veda; an epithet of Brahmā; heaven, paradise; water; opinion, conception; (अस्, ई, अम्), containing in one's self, spacious; a place where anything is preserved or kept; (अम्), n. a basis, foundation, support, prop, stay; the firm soil of the earth; any-thing that is undermost or innermost; a receptacle, reservoir; water. —धरुण-ह्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. trembling in its innermost foundations ?; (Sāy.) obstructing the flow of waters.
धरुण 2. धरुण, अस्, m. (fr. rt. धे?), Ved. a sucking calf; (for 1. धरुण see p. 449, col. 2; cf. धारु।)
धर्णस: धर्णस, अस्, आ, अम्, or धर्णसि or धर्णि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. bearing, supporting, sustaining; a supporter; strong, energetic, powerful, able; full of spirit (as Soma); firm, durable; (धर्णसि in Naigh. II. 9. is one of the synonyms of बल, strength.)
धर्तव्य: धर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be upheld or supported; to be held, had or possessed; to be placed or fixed.
धर्तृ: धर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, holding, bearing, supporting; (ता), m. a bearer, supporter, preserver.
धर्त्र: धर्त्र, अम्, n. a prop, a stay; a house; a sacri-fice; virtue, moral merit.
धर्म: 1. धर्म, अस्, अम्, m. n. (rarely n.; the older form which occurs in the Ṛg-veda is धर्मन्, q. v.; for 2. धर्म see p. 451, col. 3), that which is to be held fast or kept, ordinance, statute, law, usage, practice, custom, the customary observances of caste, sect, &c.; religion, piety; prescribed course of conduct, duty, (thus ‘giving alms’ &c. is the धर्म of the house-holder, ‘administering justice’ of a king, ‘piety’ of a Brāhman, ‘courage’ of a Kṣatriya); right, justice, equity, anything right, proper, or just; virtue, mora-lity, morals, merit, good works; nature, character, the peculiar state or condition of anything; an essential or characteristic quality, mark, peculiarity; manner, resemblance; any sacrifice; 2. धा, आस्, आस्, अम्, (at the end of an adj. comp.) placing; holding; containing, having; causing, &c., see किये-धा, चनो-धा, धाम-धा, धियन्-धा, &c.; (आस्), m. a placer; a holder, container, possessor, &c.; a N. of Brahmā; of Bṛhas-pati; (आस्), f. the act of placing or holding, &c., (at the end of comp., cf. तिरो-धा and दुर्-धा।) The affix धा after numerals is thought by some to be an old inst. from this धा; [cf. the use of 1. धातु after numerals.]
धाक: धाक, अस्, m. an ox; a receptacle, reservoir (= आ-धार or according to another reading आ-हार); food, boiled rice; a post.
धातु: 1. धातु, उस्, m. (for 2. धातु see p. 453, col. 3), that which is placed or laid, a deposit, layer (Ved.); a constituent or essential part, an ingredient, (thus गुण, string, is the धातु of a rope made of several strings); part, portion, (sometimes used at the end of an adj. comp. like the English ‘fold,’ see त्रि-धातु, सप्त-ध्°); an element, primary or elementary substance, primitive matter (of which five are usually reckoned or with Brahma six, thus enumerated by Yājñavalkya III. 145: 1. ब्रह्म, the eternal spirit; 2. ख or आकाश, ether; 3. अनिल, air; 4. तेजस्, fire; 5. जल, water; 6. भू, earth: the Buddhists substitute विज्ञान for ब्रह्म: the eighteen ele-ments or धातु-लोकस् of the southern Buddhists are the five organs of sense with मनस्, the six qualities observed by these, and six ideas produced by these six qualities); constituent element or essential ingre-dient of the body, primary or essential fluid or juice, a secretion, (the number of which is variously given as seven or ten; these Dhātus are distinct from the five elements of which the body also consists, and are sometimes regarded as Rasas, i. e. secretions or fluids; they are chyle, blood, flesh, fat, bone, marrow, and semen, to which must be added hair, skin, and sinews, if ten are reckoned); a humor or affection of the body (viz. phlegm, wind, and bile); a bone; (according to some) any one of the five organs of sense; any one of the five properties or qualities of the elements observed by the organs of sense (viz. sound, tangibility, colour, flavour, smell, see under गुण); a primary element of the earth or of moun-tains, a mineral, fossil, metal, ore; a fluid mineral of a red colour; the primary element of words, a verbal root; [cf. उप-ध्°, काम-ध्°, गिरि-ध्°, &c.] —धातु-काय, अस्, m. ‘body of elements,’ N. of a Buddhist work by Pūrṇa. —धातु-काशीश or धातु-कासीस, अम्, n. red sulphate of iron. —धातु-कुशल, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in metals, a metallurgist, mineralogist. —धातु-क्रिया, f. metallurgy, minera-logy. —धातु-क्षय, अस्, m. waste of the bodily humors, any mortal disease. —धातुक्षय-कास, अस्, m. a consumptive cough. —धातु-गर्भ, अस्, m. a receptacle for Buddhist relics, a dagop, (according to some द-गोप् = धातु-गोप।) —धातु-ग्राहिन्, ई, m. calamine. —धातु-घोषा, f., N. of a work on the verbal roots. —धातु-घ्न, अम्, n. sour gruel prepared from the fermentation of rice-water. —धातु-चन्द्रिका, f. ‘elucidation of roots,’ N. of a grammatical work by Kavi-candra. —धातु-ज = धातुक, bitumen. —धातु-दीपिका, f. ‘elucidation of roots,’ N. of a commentary by Durgā-dāsa on Vopa-deva's collection of roots. —धातु-द्रावक, ‘dissolving metals,’ borax, tinkal. —धातु-नाशन, अम्, n. ‘destroying the humors,’ sour gruel; [cf. धातु-घ्न।] —धातु-न्याय-मञ्जाषा, f., N. of a work on the radicals. —धातु-प, अस्, m. the alimentary juice or chyle, the chief of the seven elementary ingredients of the body. —धातु-पा-ठ, अस्, m. ‘recital of roots,’ a list or collection of roots compiled and arranged according to Pāṇini's system, (the most important and well-known Dhātu-pāṭha is ascribed to Pāṇini himself.) —धातु-पारा-यण or धातु-पारायणीय, अम्, n., N. of a work on verbal roots. —धातु-पुष्टि, इस्, f. nutrition of the bodily humors. —धातु-पुष्पी and धातु-पु-ष्पिका, f. a plant, = धातृ-पुष्पी. —धातु-प्र-दीप, अस्, m., N. of a commentary by Maitreya-rakṣita on the Dhātu-pāṭha. —धातुप्रदीप-दी-पिका or धातुप्रदीप-टीका, f., N. of a commentary on the preceding work. —धातु-भृत्, त्, m. ‘bear-ing metals,’ a mountain; (त्, त्, त्), promoting the elementary juices or secretions, robust. —धातु-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a commentary by Kāśī-nātha on the Dhātu-pāṭha. —धातु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, con-taining or possessing elements or elementary sub-stances, abounding in minerals or metals. —धातु-मत्-ता, f. richness in metals &c. —धातु-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of or abounding in metals, metallic. —धातु-मल, अम्, n. impure excretion from the essential fluids of the body; lead (the most impure of metals). —धातु-माक्षिक, अम्, n. a mineral substance, sulphuret of iron. —धातु-मारिन्, ई, m. ‘dissolving metals,’ sulphur; (इणी), f. borax. —धातु-रत्न-माला, f., N. of a medical work by Deva-datta. —धातु-रत्नावली, f. ‘a necklace or string of roots,’ N. of a metrical collection of roots by Rādhā-kṛṣṇa. —धातु-राजक, अम्, n. ‘the chief of the essential fluids of the body,’ semen, the seminal fluid. —धातु-लक्षण, अम्, n., N. of a work. —धातु-वल्लभ, अम्, n. ‘friend of metals,’ borax (used as a flux). —धातु-वाद, अस्, m. metal-lurgy, mineralogy. —धातुवादिन्, ई, m. an assayer, miner, mineralogist, metallurgist. —धातु-विकार, अस्, m. = धातु-क्षय. —धातु-विष्, ट्, f. = धातु-मल, lead. —धातु-वृत्ति, इस्, f. a commentary on the roots. —धातु-वैरिन्, ई, m. ‘enemy of metals,’ sulphur. —धातु-शेखर, अम्, n. ‘chief of mine-rals,’ green sulphate of iron or green vitriol. —धातु-शोधन or धातु-सम्भव, lead. —धातु-सा-म्य, अम्, n. equilibrium of the bodily humors, good health. —धातु-हन्, ‘killing metals,’ sulphur. —धातूपल (°तु-उप्°), अस्, m. ‘the stone among metals,’ chalk. —धात्व्-अर्थ, अस्, m. ‘having the sense of a root,’ i. e. a verb.

धातु 2. धातु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. धे; for 1. धातु see p. 452, col. 3), Ved. to be drunk or sucked in?; (Sāy.) sustainer, supporter, (fr. rt. 1. धा); (उस्), m. anything to be drunk or sucked, milk, &c.; (उस्), f. a milch cow.
धातुक: धातुक (at the end of comp.) = धातु; bitumen.
धातृ: धातृ, ता, m. one who places or lays, a founder [cf. Lat. con-ditor], maker, creator, originator, author; orderer, arranger; bearer, supporter, main-tainer, preserver; N. of a divine being who is the creator, arranger, maintainer, and manager of all things, (strictly perhaps without any distinct and definite place in the Hindū mythological system, but rather the personification of the various ideas and functions inherent in the rt. 1. धा; he is not mentioned in the older hymns of the Ṛg-veda, but is invoked in the tenth Maṇḍala, and agrees in many points with Tvaṣṭṛ and Prajā-pati; he is described as promoting generation, presiding over matri-mony and domestic life, preserving health, curing diseases and broken limbs, granting riches, ordering times and seasons, &c.; not only is he associated with Tvaṣṭṛ and Prajā-pati, but with Savitṛ and Bṛhas-pati; sometimes with Mitra, Viṣṇu, and Aryaman, and occasionally identified with Prajā-pati: in one Brāhmaṇa Dhātṛ and Aryaman are declared to be the first-born children of Aditi: in epic poetry Dhātṛ is one of the twelve Ādityas, and in post-vedic mythology the name Dhātṛ is applicable to Prajā-pati and to Brahmā as ‘creator and maintainer of the world;’ in the Bhagavad-gītā it is applied to Kṛṣṇa in the same sense; elsewhere Dhātṛ and Vidhātṛ are associated as sons of Brahmā, the goddess Lakṣmī being then their sister, and in another place as children of Bhṛgu and Khyāti); one of the seven sages of the fourth Manv-antara; one of the forty-nine winds; the paramour of a married woman, an adulterer; N. of the forty-fourth year in the cycle of Jupiter. —धातृ-पुत्र, अस्, m. ‘Brahmā's son,’ especially an epithet of Sanat-kumāra. —धातृ-पुष्पिका or धातृ-पुष्पी, f. Grislea Tomentosa. —धातृ-भवन, अम्, n. Brahmā's heaven.
धात्र: धात्र, अम्, n. a vessel for holding anything, a receptacle; (अस्, ई, अम्), belonging to Dhātṛ.
धात्री: धात्री, f. See under 2. धातु, col. 3.

धात्री, f. a wet-nurse, foster-mother, nurse, mother; the earth; Emblica Myrobalan, Emblica Officinalis. —धात्री-पुत्र, अस्, m. the son of a nurse, a foster-brother; an actor; (a various reading for धर्मी-पुत्र।) —धात्री-फल, अम्, n. the fruit of the Emblic Myrobalan.

Soma with grain.

A. धावति, -ते, दधाव, -ए, धाविष्यति, -ते, अधावीत्, अधाविष्ट, धावितुम्, to rub, rub off, cleanse, clean, wash, purify, polish, brighten, make pure or bright; A. to rub one's self with anything, to rub into one's person: Caus. धावयति, &c., Aor. अदी-धवत्, to cleanse, wash: Desid. दिधाविषति, -ते: Intens. दाधाव्यते; [cf. probably Goth. daupya = Old Sax. dopyu = Mod. Germ. taufe, ‘I baptize,’ = Caus. धावयामि।]
धावक: 1. धावक, अस्, आ, अम्, running, flowing, going quickly, running in advance, expeditious; (अस्), m., N. of an author in the pay of king Śrī-harṣa; (also read भासक; he is said to have composed the Ratnāvalī for Śrī-harṣa.)
धावक, अस्, आ, अम्, washing, cleansing; (अस्), m. a washerman, a dhobī.
धावत्: धावत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, running, going quickly, running away.
धावन: 1. धावन, अम्, n. running, galloping, flowing, moving; attack, assault; (अस्), m., N. of a spell for using or restraining magical weapons.
2. धावन, अम्, n. rubbing off, washing off, cleans-ing, purifying; rubbing with anything, (in comp., e. g. मीन-धावन-तोय, मनःशिला-चन्दन-ध्°, q. v.)
धावमान: धावमान, अस्, आ, अम्, running, going quickly.
धावित: 1. धावित, अस्, आ, अम्, running, running off or away; running towards, advanced against.
2. धावित, अस्, आ, अम्, purified, cleansed, clean.
धावितृ: धावितृ, ता, m. a runner; running.
धाविन्: धाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, running, going quickly.
धाव: धाव, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansing, washing, making bright, polishing, (at the end of an adj. comp.; cf. चैल-ध्° and असि-ध्°।)
धावनि: धावनि, इस्, ई, f. a sort of creeping plant, Hedy-sarum Lagopodioides.
धावनिका: धावनिका, f. a kind of prickly nightshade, = कण्ट-कारिका।
धौत: धौत, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansed, &c. See p. 460, col. 2.

धौत धौत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. धाव्), washed, cleansed, cleaned, purified, washed off; polished, brightened, whetted; white, bright, silvered, shining; (अम्), n. silver. —धौत-कट, अस्, m. a bag of coarse cloth, a sack made of kind of mat-ting. —धौत-कोषज or धौत-कौषेय or धौत-कौशेय, अम्, n. bleached or purified silk (= पत्त्रोर्ण). —धौत-खण्डी, f. sugar-candy. —धौत-बली, f. = धौताञ्जली, (probably rather धौताञ्जनी, q. v.) —धौत-मूलक, अस्, m., N. of a prince of the Cīnas. —धौत-शिल, अम्, n. ‘bright stone,’ crystal, rock-crystal. —धौताञ्जनी, f. a sort of collyrium, = त्र्यङ्कट or त्र्यङ्गट। —धौतापाङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having the corners of the eyes brightened.
धावल्य: धावल्य धावल्य, अम्, n. (fr. धवल), whiteness, white (the colour).
धासस्: धासस् धासस्, आस्, m., Ved. a mountain.
धि: धि 1. धि (allied to rt. 1. धा), cl. 6. P. धियति, दिधाय, धेष्यति, अधैषीत्, धेतुम्, to have, hold, keep, possess.
2. धि, इस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. धा), what holds, con-tains or preserves; any receptacle, (only at the end of a comp., e. g. अम्बु-धि, अम्भो-धि, इषु-धि, उत्स-धि, उद-धि, जल-धि, &c.)
धि 3. धि or धिन्व्, cl. 5. P. धिनोति, दि-धिन्व, धिन्वितुम्, to satisfy (Ved.); to delight, please.
धि 4. धि sometimes = 2. अधि, as पि = अपि and व = अव।
धित: 1. धित, अस्, आ, अम् (earlier form of हित fr. rt. 1. धा), put, placed, arranged, given, caused; re-solved; [cf. दुर्-ध्° and नेम-ध्°।]
2. धित, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied, pleased.
धितावन्: धितावन्, आ, m., Ved. abounding in gifts (?). (According to Sāy. Ṛg-veda III. 27, 2, धितावा-नम् = धित-वानम् = निहित-धनम्, laying up or granting wealth; III. 40, 3, = निहित-हविष्कम्, [a sacrifice] in which oblations are offered.)
धिति: धिति in नेम-ध्°, मित्र-ध्°, &c., q. v.
धिक्: धिक् धिक्, ind. (said to be connected with rt. 1. दिह्), an interjection of reproach, menace or displeasure, = fie! shame! out upon! what a pity! &c.; (generally followed by the acc., sometimes by the nom. or voc., and rarely by the gen., e. g. धिक् त्वाम्, shame upon thee! धिग् इयम् दरिद्रता, shame upon this poverty!) —धिक्-पारुष्य, अम्, n. abuse, reproach, excessive reviling. —धिग्-दण्ड, अस्, m. reprimand, censure.
धिक्कृ: धिक्-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to reproach, censure, reprimand, curse (with acc.). —धिक्-कार, अस्, m. or धिक्-क्रिया, f. reproach, contempt, cen-sure, disrespect. —धिक्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, reproached, reviled, censured, condemned, cursed; (अम्), n. a reproach, contempt, curse.
धिक्ष्: धिक्ष् धिक्ष् (perhaps a Desid. form of rt. 1. दह्, cf. rt. धुक्ष्), cl. 1. A. धिक्षते, &c., to kindle; to live; to be weary or harassed.
धिग्वण: धिग्वण धिग्वण, अस्, m. (perhaps a Prā-kṛt form of धिक्-वर्ण), a man of a low or mixed caste, sprung from a Brāhman and a female of the tribe called Āyogava.
धित्स्य: धित्स्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be wished to be placed, &c.; desirable to be given or created, &c.
धिन्व्: धिन्व् धिन्व्। See rt. 3. धि, col. 2.
धिप्सु: धिप्सु धिप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. दम्भ्), wishing to trick or deceive, deceptive.
धियञ्जिन्व: धियञ्जिन्व धियञ्-जिन्व, धियाय, धिया-वसु। See p. 456, col. 1.
धिष्: धिष् 1. धिष् (thought by some to be an abbreviated form of a Vedic Desid. दिधिष् derived fr. rt. 1. धा; connected with rt. 1. धी), cl. 3. P. दिधेष्टि, &c., to sound, emit a sound; to praise, celebrate by hymns (?).

2. धिष्, f. (only occurring in inst. धिषा and probably connected with rt. 1. धी), fixing the mind, attention (?), intelligence (?), devotion; (Sāy.) = धि-षणा, knowledge, understanding; action; praise, hymn.
धिषण: धिषण, अस्, m. (said to be fr. धिष् substi-tuted for rt. धृष्), ‘the intelligent one,’ N. of Bṛhas-pati, preceptor of the gods and regent of the planet Jupiter, the planet Jupiter itself [cf. धिष-णाधिप and धी-मत्]; any Guru or spiritual pre-ceptor; epithet of a Nārāyaṇa; N. of an astronomer; of an evil spirit or demon; (आ), f. a sort of Soma-vessel, a cup, goblet, bowl; a Soma press; (accord-ing to some commentators) the Soma juice itself and its effects; (metaphorically धिषणे, f. du. the two cups or bowls, i. e. the two worlds or heaven and earth; and धिषणास्, f. pl. the three worlds or heaven, earth, and the intermediate atmosphere); a female divinity presiding over prosperity and gain, (sometimes reckoned among the wives of the gods); = वाच्, speech, praise, hymn; = 2. धी, intelligence, intellect, understanding, knowledge; N. of the wife of Havir-dhāna, daughter of Agni; of the wife of Kṛśāśva and mother of Veda-śira, Devala, Vayuna, and Manu; (अम्), n. a dwelling-place, abode, seat, site, resting-place [cf. धिष्ण्य]; understanding, intellect. —धिषणाधिप, अस्, m. ‘lord of the planet Jupiter,’ epithet of Bṛhas-pati.
धिषण्य: धिषण्य, an adj. formed by Yāska (Nir. VIII. 3) to explain धिष्ण्य।
धिषण्यत्: धिषण्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. a Nom. धिषण्य which only occurs in the part.), attentive, devout (?); (Sāy.) desiring to praise.
धिष्ट्य: धिष्ट्य, अस्, आ, अम्, placed on a fire-altar (?); (wrong reading for धिष्ण्य, q. v.)
धिष्ठ्य: धिष्ठ्य, अम्, n. site, seat, place, (wrong reading for धिष्ण्य, q. v.); (अस्), m. fire; the planet Venus (?). —धिष्ठ्य-प, अस्, m. world-protector.
धिष्णीय: धिष्णीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. intended for or belonging to the Dhiṣṇyas, i. e. certain receptacles or places for fire.
धिष्ण्य: धिष्ण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. only perceptible by the mind; (Sāy. = धार्ष्ट्य-युक्त), endowed with fortitude; intelligent, thoughtful, devout, pious; (Sāy.) to be praised or meditated upon; worthy of a high station; placed upon the heaps of earth used for side-altars; see below. In Ṛg-veda III. 22, 3, Sāy. explains धिष्ण्या by प्राणास् = the divinities presiding over the vital airs; (अस्), m. a place for the sacrificial fire, a sort of inferior or side-altar, (generally a heap of earth covered with sand on which the fire is placed, and of which eight are enumerated, cf. आग्नीध्रीय, मार्जालीय, &c.); an epithet of Uśanas, the planet Venus; power, strength; (अम्), n. a site, seat, place, abode, spot, region, house; a star, asterism, (looking like the fire on the side-altars); a meteor.
धी: धी 1. धी (sometimes given in the redu-plicated form दीधी; the later forms of धी are 1. धा, ध्या, ध्यै, q. v., with which such Vedic forms as धीमहि are connected by native commentators), cl. 2. A. दीधीते, &c., to shine, appear (see दीधी); cl. 1. P. (fr. rt. ध्यै), ध्या-यति, &c. (see ध्यै), to perceive, think, reflect; to wish, desire. (A root धी, cl. 4. A. धीयते, &c., which is properly Pass. of rt. 1. धा, is given in the Dhātu-pāṭha and is said to have the following senses, — to contain, hold; to slight, disregard; to accomplish; to propitiate.)

2. धी, ईस्, f. thought, idea, notion, intention; understanding, wisdom, intellect, intelligence, intel-lectual power, mind; knowledge, science, art; reli-gious reflection, devotion, prayer; a religious rite, sacrifice; Intelligence personified (as the wife of Rudra in the form Manyu); (in astrology) the fifth house from the Lagna; (इयस्), f. pl. Holy Thoughts per-sonified; [cf. इत्था-धी, उदार-धी, दुर्-धी, दू-ढी, सु-धी, &c.] —धियञ्-जिन्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. exciting pious reflection or promoting devotion; (Sāy.) to be propitiated by pious rites; (आ), m. du. epithet of the Aśvins. —धियन्-धा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. reflecting, devout, pious, wise; (Sāy.) celebrating sacred rites. —धिया-जुर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, Ved. worn out or grown old in the performance of religious duties. —धियाम्-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the thoughts,’ the soul; an epithet of Mañju-ghoṣa. —धिया-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. abounding in devotion, very devout; (Sāy.) recompensing religious rites by wealth. —धी-जवन, अस्, आ, अम्, or धी-जू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. infusing spirit, inspiring; (Sāy.) rapid as thought. —धीन्द्रिय (धी-इन्°), अस्, m. an organ of per-ception (= बुद्धीन्द्रिय and opposed to कर्मेन्-द्रिय, see इन्द्रिय). —धी-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pos-sessed of understanding, endowed with intelligence, intellectual, intelligent, wise, learned, sensible; (आन्), m. an epithet of Bṛhas-pati, preceptor of the gods; N. of a son of Virāj; of a son of Purū-ravas. —धी-मन्त्रिन्, ई, m. a minister for counsel (as distinguished fr. कर्म-मन्त्रिन्, a minister for action). —धी-मरण, अस्, m. (with preceding मिश्र), N. of a man. —धी-रण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. delighting in devotion; (Sāy.) whose speech is with praise, a devout worshipper. —धी-राज, अस्, m., N. of one of the attendants of Śiva. —धी-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. intelligent, pious, religious. —धी-शक्ति, इस्, f. power of the mind, mental or intellectual faculty (as atten-tion, comprehension, &c.). —धी-सख, अस्, m. a wise counsellor, an adviser, mentor, minister; a tutor or friendly adviser. —धी-सचिव, अस्, m. a minister for counsel, a counsellor, minister; a wise or prudent adviser. —धी-हरा, f. a kind of sweet gourd.
धियसान: धियसान, अस्, आ, अम्, reflecting, meditating upon, fixing the mind upon.
धियाय: धियाय (fr. 2. धी), Nom. A. धियायते, &c., Ved. to fix the mind upon; to be devout, practise devotion; (Sāy.) to wish for praise.
धियाय, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the preceding), Ved. reflect-ing, devout, pious; (Sāy.) wishing to understand.
धीत: 1. धीत, अस्, आ, अम्, reflected on, thought about.
धीत 2. धीत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. धे), drunk, sucked, sucked in, sucked out. —धीत-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, having the juice sucked out or extracted.
धीति: 1. धीति, इस्, f. (for 2. धीति see col. 2), Ved. thought, notion, reflection, idea; devotion, prayer; (अयस्), f. pl. understanding, wisdom; (Sāy.) the fingers.
2. धीति, इस्, f. (for 1. धीति see col. 1), drink-ing; (according to the commentators), thirst.
धीतिक: धीतिक, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist patriarch.
धीदा: 1. धीदा, f. (for 2. धीदा see col. 2), understand-ing, intellect.
धीदा 2. धीदा, f. (probably a Prākṛt form for दुहिता), a daughter, a virgin, a maiden. (For 1. धीदा see col. 1.)
धीवन्: धीवन्, आ, वरी, अ, Ved. clever, skilful; (आ), m. an artizan, artificer, a worker in brass; a fisher-man; [cf. the next.]
धीवर: धीवर, अस्, m. a fisherman, fisher; (ई), f. a fisherman's wife; a sort of harpoon for catching fish; a receptacle for fish, a fish-basket; (अम्), n. iron; [cf. तीव्र।]
धीवरक: धीवरक, अस्, m. a fisherman, fisher.
धीक्ष्: धीक्ष् धीक्ष् (perhaps Desid. of rt. 1. दिह्), cl. 1. A. धीक्षते, &c., Ved. to wish to anoint.
धीर: धीर धीर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. धृ, but said to be fr. rt. 1. धा and certainly connected with this latter rt.), steady, holding firmly, steadfast, en-during, durable, lasting, constant, continual; firm, determined, resolute, persevering, persistent; strong, energetic, courageous; brave, bold, daring, head-strong, self-controlled, strong-minded, self-possessed, composed, calm, collected; sedate, grave, solemn, sober; deep, grave, hollow, low, dull (as sound); emitting a long or prolonged sound; lazy, dull, slow; gentle, soft (as a breeze); well-conducted, well-behaved, well-bred; (fr. 1. धा = 1. धी), in-telligent, wise, prudent; sensible, learned, skilful, clever, shrewd; (अस्), m. the ocean, sea; ‘the wise one,’ epithet of a Buddha; of Bali; of several men; a species of medicinal plant, = ऋषभ; (आ), f. a woman who, although jealous of a husband or lover, suppresses all expression of resentment in his pre-sence; an intoxicating beverage; N. of several medi-cinal plants, = काकोली, = महा-ज्योतिष्मती, = क्षी-र-काकोली, श्वेत-वचा, मेदा, Rosa Glandulifera; (अम्), n. saffron; (अम्), ind. firmly, steadily, resolutely, steadfastly. —धीर-गोविन्द-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of the author of the modern work Āthar-vaṇa-rahasya. —धीर-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, strong-minded, self-possessed, courageous. —धीर-ता, f. or धीर-त्व, अम्, n. firmness, fortitude, energy, courage; suppression; the female property of suppressing violent expression of jealousy; refusal. —धीर-ध्वनि, इस्, m. a deep sound. —धीर-पत्त्री, f. a kind of bulbous plant (= धरणी-कन्द). —धीर-प्रशंसा, f. ‘the praise of the firm or of the wise,’ N. of the thirteenth chapter of the Śārṅgadhara-paddhati. —धीर-प्रशान्त, अस्, m. the hero of a poem or play who is both brave and calm or mild (?). —धीर-ललित, अस्, m. the hero of a poem or play who is firm and brave but reckless and sportive at the same time; (आ), f., N. of a metre consisting of four lines of sixteen syllables each. —धीर-स्कन्-ध, अस्, m. ‘strong-shouldered,’ a buffalo. —धीरा-धीरा (°र-अध्°), f. a mistress or wife who having cause for jealousy pursues a middle course between suppression and expression of resentment, a jealous woman who alternately expresses and conceals her jealousy. —धीरेश-मिश्र (°र-ईश-म्°), अस्, m., N. of a man. —धीरेश्वर (°र-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of the father of Jyotir-īśvara, author of the Dhūrta-samā-gama. —धीरोदात्त (°र-उद्°), अस्, m. the hero of a poem or play who is brave and noble-minded. —धीरोद्धत (°र-उद्°), अस्, m. the hero of a poem or play who is brave but haughty. —धीरोष्-णिन् (°र-उष्°), ई, m., N. of one of the Viśve-devās.
धीरावी: धीरावी, f., N. of a plant (= पीतशिंशपा).
धीर्य: धीर्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. धा = 1. धी), Ved. intelligent, wise, clever; (अम्), n. intelligence, pru-dence.
धीलटी: धीलटी धीलटी, f. (probably a Prākṛt form for दुहितृ), a daughter.
धु: धु 1. धु = rt. 1. धू, to shake, q. v.
धुत: धुत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, agitated, moved quickly to and fro; abandoned, deserted, left. —धुत-पाप, अस्, आ, अम्, purified from sin.
धुन: धुन, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking. See col. 3.

धुन धुन, अस्, आ, अम् (variously derived fr. rt. 2. ध्वन् or rt. 1. धु), Ved. sounding, roaring; shaking, agitating, (only in comp.) —धुनेति (°न-इति), इस्, इस्, इ, having a roaring or blustering course; having an agitating or destructive course.
धुन; add — (अम्), n. one million billions.
धुनान: धुनान, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking, agitating.
धुनि: धुनि, इस्, इस्, इ। See col. 3.

धुनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. sounding, roaring, blustering; (Sāy.) shaking, agitating, causing to tremble, (fr. rt. 1. धु); (इस्), m. epithet of the Soma; N. of a demon slain by Indra; (इस् or धुनी), f. a river [cf. नदी]; (अयस्), m. pl. ‘the agitators,’ an epithet of the Maruts. —धुनि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. roaring, sounding; (Sāy.) agitated, trembling. —धुनि-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. habitually roaring or bluster-ing; (Sāy.) whose function is the agitation or shaking (of trees &c.). —धुनी-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of the rivers,’ the ocean.
धुन्वत्: धुन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, shaking, agitating.
धुन्वान: धुन्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking, agitating.
धुवन: धुवन, अस्, m., Ved. fire; (अम्), n. shaking, agitation; place of execution.
धुवित्र: धुवित्र, अम्, n. a sort of fan (made of deer-skin and especially used to kindle or excite a sacrificial fire); [cf. धवित्र।]
धुक: धुक धुक, अस्, आ, m. f. a kind of plant (commonly Bhuyabora or Rānabora, बोर = बदर).
धुक्ष्: धुक्ष् धुक्ष्, cl. 1. A. धुक्षते, &c., to kindle; to be weary; to live.
धुङ्क्षा: धुङ्क्षा धुङ्क्षा, f., Ved. a kind of bird.
धुनय: धुनय (fr. धुनि below), Nom. P. A. धुन-यति, -ते, &c., Ved. to sound, roar, to flow with a roaring noise; to flow.
धुन्धु: धुन्धु धुन्धु, उस्, m., N. of an Asura slain by Kuvalāśva (or Kuvalayāśva), father of Sunda; (a various reading for चुञ्चु who was a descendant of Tri-śaṅku.) —धुन्धु-मार, अस्, m. ‘the slayer of Dhundhu,’ epithet of Kuvalāśva (Kuvalayāśva), a son of Tri-śaṅku and father of Yuvanāśva; a house-lizard (? = गृहालिक); an insect, coccinella (= इन्द्र-गोप, शक्र-गोप); a kind of plant (= गृह-धूम); the smoke of a house (?), cf. दुन्दु-मार. —धुन्धुमारोपाख्यान (°र-उप्°), अम्, n. ‘the episode of Dhundhu-māra,’ N. of the seventeenth chapter of the Svarga-khaṇḍa or third part of the Padma-Purāṇa.
धुर्: धुर् धुर्, ऊर्, f. (fr. rt. धृ?, in Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 2876. धुर् is masc.), that part of a yoke which rests on the shoulder; a yoke; a bur-den, load (literally and metaphorically); the peg or pin at both ends of an axle for fastening the nave of the wheel; the foremost part of the pole, where the yoke is fixed; the pole itself, the shaft, the fore-most or highest place, the top, the place of honour; a finger; N. of six verses of the Bahish-pavamāna which are to be sung in a peculiar manner; (some lexicographers add the following meanings) agitation, trembling; reflection, recollection; a spark of fire; a part, a portion; wealth; a N. of the Ganges; धुरि, ind. at the head of, = अग्रे; [cf. धूर्, दुर्-धुर्, दृढ-धुर्।] —धुरन्-धर, अस्, ई, अम्, bear-ing the yoke, bearing a burden, fit to be harnessed; bearing a burden with patience, (figuratively) laden with good qualities or with weighty duties, &c.; (अस्), m. a beast of burden; a man of business; a chief, leader; an epithet of Śiva; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; N. of a Rakṣas; the tree Grislea Tomen-tosa. —धुर्-गत, धुर्-वह, धुर्-वोढृ, incor-rect forms for धूर्-गत, धूर्-वह, धूर्-वोढृ; see under 2. धूर्, p. 458, col. 2.
धुर: धुर, अस्, m. at end of comp. = धुर्, a yoke, pole; burden; pin at the end of an axle &c.; (1. धुरा), f. a burden, load. —धुरा-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing a burden (= धूर्-वह).
धुरीण: धुरीण, अस्, आ, अम्, fit to be harnessed; bearing a burden or able to bear one, laden with, abounding with (qualities, duties, &c.); (अस्), m. a beast of burden; a man of business; a leader, chief; [cf. उत्तर-ध्°, एक-ध्°, दक्षिण-ध्°, सर्व-ध्°।]
धुरीय: धुरीय, अस्, आ, अम्, able to bear a burden, fit for a load, suited to a burden; charged with important duties; (अस्), m. a beast of burden; a man of business or one entrusted with weighty affairs.
धुर्य: धुर्य or (sometimes wrongly spelt) धूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit to be harnessed, fit for a burden, able to bear one, &c.; standing at the head, holding the first place, foremost, best; a leader; (अस्), m. a beast of burden, a horse or bullock attached to the shaft, shafter; a leader, chief (e. g. कुल-धुर्य, the chief or leader of a family); a minister, a chargé d'affaires; a kind of medicinal plant, = ऋषभ; (अम्), n. the fore-part of the pole.
धुरा: धुरा 2. धुरा, ind. (for 1. see धुर, p. 456, col. 3), violently, hurtfully, (perhaps fr. rt. धुर्व् or धूर्व्।)
धुर्व्: धुर्व् धुर्व् [cf. rt. धूर्व्], cl. 1. P. धुर्-वति, &c., to hurt, kill.
धुवका: धुवका धुवका, f. the introductory stanza of a song, forming afterwards the burden of each verse; [cf. ध्रुवका।]
धुशुल्या: धुशुल्या धुशुल्या (?), f., N. of a river.
धुस्तुर: धुस्तुर धुस्तुर or धुस्तूर, अस्, m. the thorn-apple, Datura Fastuosa; [cf. धत्तूर।]
धू: धू 1. धू, cl. 5. P. A. धूनोति, धूनुते, (in the later language also) धुनोति, धु-नुते; cl. 6. P. धुवति; cl. 9. P. A. धुनाति, धु-नीते, दुधाव, दुधुवे, धोष्यति and धविष्-यति, -ते, अधावीत् and अधौषीत्, (cl. 6. Aor. अधुवीत्), अधोष्ट and अधविष्ट, धोतुम् and धवितुम्, to shake, shake off, remove; to agitate, cause to tremble; to treat (a person) roughly, hurt, injure; to blow away, destroy; to kindle, excite, fan (a fire &c.); to shake off from one's self, liberate one's self from (A.); to strive against, re-sist: Pass. धूयते: Caus. धावयति and धून-यति, -यितुम्, to shake: Desid. दुधूषति, -ते: Intens. दोधूयते, दोधोति, दोधवीति, to shake or agitate violently, shake in a threatening manner, shake out, shake down from; to be shaken violently, totter exceedingly (A.); [cf. Zend dun-man, ‘mist, fog:’ Gr. θύ-ω, θύ-ν-ω, θυά-ω, θυά-ζω, θῦ-νο-ς, θύ-ελλα, θυά-(δ)-ς, θυι-ά-ς, θυ-μό-ς, θῦ-μα, θυ-σία, θύ-ος, θυή-εις, θύ-μο-ν: Lat. fū-mu-s, sub-fī-o, sub-fī-men: Goth. daun-s, ‘smell:’ Old Iceland. du-s-t = Eng. dust: Old Germ. tun-s-t, ‘storm;’ tou-m, ‘smoke:’ Slav. du-na-ti, ‘to breathe;’ dy-mŭ, ‘smoke;’ du-chŭ, ‘breath;’ du-sha, ‘soul:’ Lith. dú-mai, ‘smoke;’ du-ma-s, dū-mà, ‘thought, mind.’]
धूक: धूक, अस्, m. air or wind; a rogue, cheat; time; a kind of plant (= वकुल).
धूत: धूत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, shaken off, removed, agitated; fanned, rinsed, cleansed (in this sense said to be an old form for धौत, q. v.); deserted, aban-doned; reproached, reviled; judged, discriminated; (अम्), n. (?), good behaviour; (आ), f. a wife. —धूत-कल्मष, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose sins are shaken off, free from sin, pure. —धूत-पाप, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has shaken off his sins; removing or destroying sin; (आ), f., N. of a river; of the daughter of the ascetic Veda-śiras. —धूतपाप-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —धूतपापेश्वर-तीर्थ (°प-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place. —धूत-पाप्मन्, आ, आ, अ, = धूत-पाप, q. v.
धूति: धूति, इस्, m., Ved. ‘a shaker, agitator,’ N. of an Āditya; (इस्), f. shaking, moving to and fro, fanning; (अयस्), m. pl. epithet of the Maruts.
धूत्वा: धूत्वा, ind. having shaken or shaken off; having agitated.
धून: धून, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, agitated; distressed by heat or thirst.
धूनन: धूनन, अस्, m. wind; (अम्), n. the act of shaking, agitation.
धूनय: धूनय (fr. धून), Nom. P. A. धूनयति, -ते, &c. (generally considered as the Caus. of rt. 1. धू), to shake, agitate, move to and fro.
धूप: धूप, अस्, m. (by native authorities derived fr. a rt. धूप्, q. v.), incense, frankincense, perfume, aromatic vapour or smoke, the vapour proceeding from fragrant gum or resin, (often in pl. धूपास्); fragrant powder; [cf. कृत्रिम-ध्°, कॢप्त-ध्°, ख-ध्°, &c.] —धूप-दान, अम्, n. ‘the giving of incense,’ N. of a chapter of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva by Halāyudha. —धूप-धूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, made fragrant or fumigated with incense. —धूप-पात्र, अम्, n. a vessel for incense, censer; a perfume box. —धूप-वृक्ष or धूपवृक्षक, अस्, m. ‘incense-tree,’ a species of pine, Pinus Longifolia. —धूपागुरु (°प-अग्°), उ, n. a kind of Agallo-chum used for incense. —धूपाङ्ग (°प-अङ्°), अस्, m. turpentine. —धूपार्ह (°प-अर्°), अम्, n. a black kind of Agallochum used or fit for incense.
धूपक: धूपक, अस्, m. = धूप in कृत्रिम-ध्° and other adj. comp.; a preparer of perfumes or incense, a perfumer [cf. धूपिक।]
धूपन: धूपन, अम्, n. (fr. धूपय), incensing, fumi-gation, perfuming; perfume, incense, the aromatic vapour produced from gums or resins. —धूपनाङ्ग (°न-अङ्°), अस्, m. = धूपाङ्ग, turpentine (?).
धूपय: धूपय (fr. धूप, but native authorities recog-nise a rt. धूप्, q. v.), Nom. P. धूपयति, -यितुम्, to fumigate, perfume, incense, make fragrant; (in astron.) to obscure with mist, to be about to eclipse; to speak; to shine; [cf. Gr. τύφ-ω, τῦφ-ο-ς, τυφ-ών, τυφώς, τυφεδών, Τυμφρηστός (?), τυφλό-ς, τυφεδανός, τυφεδών: Old Germ. dimpf-en, ‘to smoke:’ Lith. dump-iù, ‘I fan or blow a fire;’ dùmp-les, ‘bellows.’]
धूपाय: धूपाय (fr. धूप, but native authorities give a rt. धूप्, q. v.), Nom. P. धूपायति, -यितुम्, to fumigate, perfume with incense; [cf. धूपय।]
धूपायित: धूपायित, अस्, आ, अम्, incensed, perfumed, fumi-gated, scented with incense; vexed, pained.
धूपि: धूपि, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a class of divine beings presiding over rain (?).
धूपिक: धूपिक, अस्, m. a preparer of perfumes or in-cense, a perfumer; [cf. धूपक।]
धूपित: धूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, scented, perfumed, incensed; suffering pain or fatigue.
धूप्य: धूप्य, अम्, n. (?), the claw of a particular ani-mal which when burned emits a fragrant perfume; [cf. Pers. nāḳhuni ḳhwuṣ.]
धूम: धूम, अस्, m. (connected by some with rt. 1. ध्मा), smoke, vapour, incense; mist, haze; breath (Ved.); a cloud; (in medic.) smoke as a sternutatory in five forms; = गो-धूम, = शिलारस, a kind of incense; a place prepared for the building of a house; N. of a man; (आ), f. a kind of plant (= धीरावी); [cf. गो-ध्°, चरिष्णु-ध्°, तृष्ट-ध्°: cf. also rt. 1. ध्मा; Gr. θῡ-μό-ς; Lat. fū-mu-s; Old Germ. daum, toum, ‘fume;’ Lith. dū-mai, ‘smoke;’ Slav. dü-mŭ, ‘smoke;’ Hib. dluimh, ‘cloud, darkness.’] —धू-म-केतन, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘smoke-marked,’ whose ensign or mark is smoke; (अस्), m. fire or its deity; a meteor, a comet; Ketu or the personified descending node. —धूम-केतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. ‘whose sign is smoke,’ known or to be known from smoke; (उस्), m. fire; a comet or falling star, the personi-fied descending node; N. of a son of Kṛśāśva by Arcis; of Tṛṇa-vindu by Alambuṣā. —धूम-गन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. smelling of smoke. —धूम-गन्धिक, अम्, n. a kind of grass (= रोहिष-तृण). —धूम-जाङ्गज (धूम-ज-अङ्°), अम्, n. ammoniac. —धूम-जाल, अम्, n. a multitude or mass of clouds or smoke. —धूम-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. seeing smoke or vapour (as a person affected with a peculiar disease of the eye). —धूम-ध्वज, अस्, m. ‘whose banner or symbol is smoke,’ fire. —धूम-प, अस्, आ, अम्, drinking or inhaling only smoke; [cf. धूम-प्राश।] —धूम-प-थ, अस्, m. ‘the way of smoke,’ sacrifice; seeking salvation by works; [cf. धूम-वर्त्मन्।] —धू-म-पान, अम्, n. inhaling smoke or vapour; smoking tobacco. —धूमपान-विधि, इस्, m. ‘the rule of inhaling smoke,’ N. of the twenty-eighth chapter of the Śārṅgadhara-saṃhitā. —धूम-प्रभा, f., N. of one of the seventeen divisions of hell where smoke takes the place of light. —धूम-प्राश, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘smoke-eating,’ feeding only on smoke, as a hermit; [cf. धूम-प।] —धूम-मङ्गज, various reading for धूम-जाङ्गज, q. v. —धूम-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of smoke or vapour, smoky. —धू-म-महिषी, f. fog, mist. —धूम-योनि, इस्, m. ‘engendered from smoke or vapour,’ a cloud. —धू-म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, smoky; smoking, steaming; containing the word धूम. —धूमवत्-त्व, अम्, n. smokiness. —धूम-वर्चस्, आस्, m., N. of a man. —धूम-वर्ण, अस्, m. ‘smoke-coloured,’ N. of a king of the serpents. —धूम-वर्त्मन्, अ, n. ‘the path of smoke,’ sacrifice; seeking salvation by works. —धूम-शिख, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘smoke-crested’ (said of flame or a tongue of fire). —धूम-संहति, इस्, f. a quantity of smoke, a mass or cloud of smoke. —धूमाकार (°म-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the form or appearance of smoke. —धू-माक्ष (°म-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. having dim, dark or troubled (?) eyes. —धूमाङ्ग (°म-अङ्°) = शिंशपा. —धूमाभ (°म-आभ), अस्, आ, अम्, of a smoky appearance or colour, of a purple colour; (अस्), m. purple. —धूमा-वती, f., N. of a place of pilgrimage. —धूमावती-मन्त्र, अस्, m. or धू-मावती-मनु, उस्, m., N. of certain magical for-mulas. —धूमावलि (°म-आव्°), इस्, f. a wreath or cloud of smoke. —धूमोत्थ (°म-उत्°), अम्, n. = वज्र-क्षार, ammoniac; [cf. धूम-जाङ्गज।] —धूमोद्गार (°म-उद्°), अस्, m. ‘the issuing of smoke or vapour,’ N. of a kind of disease. —धू-मोपहत (°म-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘smoke-struck,’ suffocated with smoke. —धूमोर्णा (°म-ऊर्°), f., N. of the wife of Yama; of the wife of Mārkaṇ-ḍeya; [cf. धूम्रोर्णा।] —धूमोर्णा-पति, इस्, m. ‘husband of Dhūmorṇā,’ epithet of Yama, ruler of the dead.
धूम धूम, धूम्र। See p. 457, cols. 2, 3.
धूमक: धूमक, अस्, आ, अम्, = धूम at the end of a comp.; (इका), f. smoke, vapour, fog. —धू-मक-पुष्पा, f. a species of plant (compared to smoke).
धूमय: धूमय (fr. धूम), Nom. P. धूमयति, &c., to cover with smoke, obscure with mist: Pass. धूम्यते, &c., to be obscured with vapour or mist; to be about to be eclipsed, to be darkened; [cf. धूमाय।]
धूमल: धूमल, अस्, आ, अम्, smoke-coloured, of a smoky hue, brownish red, of a purple colour; (अस्), m. a colour compounded of black and red, purple; a kind of musical instrument.
धूमस: धूमस, अस्, m. the plant Tectona Grandis; (ई), f. a sort of cake made of pulse steeped in water and dried in the sun.
धूमाय: धूमाय (fr. धूम), Nom. P. A. धूमायति, -ते, -यितुम्, to smoke, be covered or obscured with smoke, to steam: Caus. P. धूमाययति, -यितुम्, to cause to smoke or to be covered with smoke, mist, vapour, &c.
धूमायन: धूमायन, अम्, n. smoking, steaming; (in medic.) heat, fever, feverishness.
धूमायित: धूमायित, अम्, n. the act of smoking.
धूमित: धूमित, अस्, आ, अम्, obscured with smoke, mist, &c., darkened; (आ), f., scil. दिश्, that quarter towards which the sun turns first.
धूमिन्: धूमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, smoking, steaming; (इनी), f., N. of one of the seven tongues of Agni; of the wife of Aja-mīḍha; of another woman.
धूम्यमान: धूम्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being obscured with mist &c., being obscured.
धूम्या: धूम्या, f. thick smoke, a volume or cloud of smoke. —धूम्याट (°या-अट), अस्, m. the fork-tailed shrike.
धूम्र: धूम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, smoky, smoke-coloured, grey; (according to the lexicographers) dark-red or the colour of fire seen through smoke; of a deep purple colour, purple; (metaphorically) dark, lurid, obscured; (अस्), m. a mixture of red and black; purple (the colour); incense. (= तुरुष्क); N. of one of Skanda's attendants; of a Dānava; of a Muni; of a monkey or bear [cf. धूम्रायण and धौ-म्रायण]; an epithet of Śiva; of Parāśara; (in astrology) N. of the twenty-eighth Yoga; (आ), f. a kind of gourd (= शशाण्डुली); epithet of Durgā; of the mother of Vasu-dhara; (अम्), n. sin, vice, wickedness; [cf. ताम्र-ध्°।] —धूम्र-केतु, उस्, m. ‘grey-bannered,’ N. of a son of Bharata; of Tṛṇa-vindu. —धूम्र-केश, अस्, m. ‘dark-haired,’ N. of a son of Pṛthu and Arcis; of a son of Kṛśāśva and Arcis [cf. धूम-केतु]; of a son of Danu. —धूम्र-गिरि, इस्, m. ‘the smoky moun-tain,’ N. of a mountain. —धूम्र-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, ‘whose intellect is dim’ or ‘whose devotion is obscured,’ devoted to works. —धूम्र-नीकाश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. of a deep dark-red colour. —धूम्र-पत्त्रा, f. ‘having grey or dark-red leaves,’ N. of a shrub (= धूम्राह्वा, सु-लभा, स्वयम्-भुवा, गृध्र-पत्त्रा, गृध्राणी, कृमि-घ्नी, श्रीम-लापहा). —धूम्र-मूलिका, f. ‘having a grey or dark-red root,’ a kind of grass (= शूली). —धूम्र-रुच्, क्, क्, क्, of a purple hue, of a deep-red colour. —धूम्र-रोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. dark-red, deep purple. —धूम्र-लोचन, अस्, m. ‘dark-eyed,’ a pigeon; ध्वनत्: ध्वनत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sounding, making a noise.
ध्वनन: ध्वनन, अम्, n. sounding; hinting at.
ध्वनयत्: ध्वनयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to sound or resound, resounding, echoing with; (अन्), m., N. of a wind.
ध्वनि: ध्वनि, इस्, m. sound, echo, noise; tone, tune; thunder; the sound of a drum; an inarticulate sound, a mere empty sound without reality; a word; allu-sion, hint, figurative allusion, implied meaning, poetical style; N. of a work. —ध्वनि-कार, अस्, or ध्वनि-कृत्, त्, m. the author of the work called Dhvani. —ध्वनि-ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘apprehending sounds,’ the ear; hearing. —ध्वनि-त्व, अम्, n. figurative allusion, poetical style. —ध्वनि-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of a man. —ध्वनि-नाला, f., N. of several musical instruments, = काहला, a sort of trumpet; the Vīṇā or lute; a pipe, fife. —ध्वनि-बोधक or ध्वनि-बोधन, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of the grass Rohisha. —ध्वनि-विकार, अस्, m. a change of voice (caused by fright or grief, &c.). —ध्वन्य्-अर्थ, अस्, m. the meaning or truth implied.
ध्वनित: ध्वनित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, making a noise (as a drum); alluded to, implied, figuratively or rhetorically expressed; (अम्), n. sound, thunder.
ध्वन्य: ध्वन्य, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
ध्वान: ध्वान, अस्, m. humming, murmuring, one of the seven kinds of speech or वाचः स्थानानि, (a degree louder than उपांशु, q. v.); sound or tone in general.
ध्वानित: ध्वानित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to sound, made resonant.

ध्वस्, ध्वत् (fr. rt. ध्वंस्), (at the end of certain comps.) causing to fall, throwing down.
ध्वसन्: ध्वसन्, आ, m., Ved., N. of a king of the Matsyas.
ध्वसनि: ध्वसनि, इस्, m., Ved. the sprinkler; sprinkling, scattering (as a cloud).
ध्वसन्ति: ध्वसन्ति, इस्, m., N. of a man.
ध्वसिर: ध्वसिर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sprinkled, spattered, covered; (Sāy.) destroyed; [cf. धूसर।]
ध्वस्त: ध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen; destroyed, perished, hurt, lost; covered, eclipsed, disappeared. —ध्वस्-ताक्ष (°त-अक्ष), अस्, ई, अम्, having the eyes sunk (as in death).
ध्वस्ति: ध्वस्ति, इस्, f. ceasing, destruction, cessation (of all the consequences of actions), one of the four states to which the Yogin attains.
ध्वस्मन्: ध्वस्मन्, आ, m., Ved. polluting, darkening; (Sāy.) destroying, destructive; causing destruction. —ध्वस्मन्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. covered?; (Sāy.) whose faults or imperfections are destroyed; (अत्), n. (according to Yāska) water.
ध्वस्र: ध्वस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sprinkling, spattering; scattering, liberal; (Sāy.) destructive; (अस्), m., N. of a king.
ध्वाक्षा: ध्वाक्षा ध्वाक्षा, f., N. of a plant and its fruit.

ध्वाङ्क्षोलिका: ध्वाङ्क्षोलिका or ध्वाङ्क्षोली, f. a medicinal plant, = काकोली।
ध्वृ: ध्वृ ध्वृ (connected with rts. ह्वृ and धूर्व्), cl. 1. P. ध्वरति, दध्वार, ध्व-रिष्यति, अध्वार्षीत् (3rd du. Aor. A. अध्वरि-षाताम् or अध्वृषाताम्); Prec. ध्वरिषीष्ट or ध्वृषीष्ट, ध्वर्तुम्, to bend, make crooked, cause to fall, fell; to kill: Caus. ध्वारयति, -यि-तुम्: Desid. दुध्वूर्षति, दिध्वरिषति: Intens. दाध्वर्यते; [cf. अ-ध्वर, 2. ध्रु; probably Angl. ध्वरस्: ध्वरस्, आस्, m. f., Ved. ‘destructive, hurtful, injurious,’ N. of certain female demons or noxious beings.
ध्वर्य: ध्वर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be bent, made crooked, &c.
ध्वृत्: ध्वृत्, त्, त्, त् (at the end of a comp.), causing to fall, felling, killing.
ध्व्रण्: ध्व्रण् ध्व्रण्, cl. 1. P. ध्व्रणति, &c., to sound; (a various reading for ध्रण्।)
